description: Ministry of Health - Food Act, No 26 of 1980, Amended the Food (Labelling and Advertising) Regulation 2022
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Health under the Food Act, No. 26 of 1980, specifically amending the Food (Labelling and Advertising) Regulations 2022. The content focuses entirely on legal/regulatory matters - amending existing regulations and specifying their operational date. While a minister is named, this is incidental to the primary purpose of publishing regulatory changes, and no detailed portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes are described. This fits Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) as it deals with regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements.
